task: [.github/workflows/codeql.yml] 'CodeQL code scanning' medyan 70 sn (32 kosu). Pip/apt adimlarina actions/cache ekle, gereksiz adimlari paths filtresiyle atla, bagimsiz test adimlarini paralel job'a bol.

evidence.description: Workflow configuration file target for optimization including dependency caching, path filtering, and job parallelization.

factual_findings: Workflow file `.github/workflows/codeql.yml` records a median execution time of 70 seconds across 32 runs.
Dependency setup in `.github/workflows/codeql.yml` does not currently utilize `actions/cache` or setup caching for Pip and apt packages.
Workflow triggers in `.github/workflows/codeql.yml` lack `paths` or `paths-ignore` filters, causing execution on changes that do not affect code scanning.
hypotheses: Adding `actions/cache` or package caching to `.github/workflows/codeql.yml` will reduce setup time during Pip/apt installation steps.
Adding path triggers to `.github/workflows/codeql.yml` will skip workflow execution on non-source code commits, reducing unnecessary run frequency.
Splitting independent setup and analysis tasks into parallel jobs within `.github/workflows/codeql.yml` will reduce overall wall-clock runtime below 70 seconds.
result.recommendation: Update `.github/workflows/codeql.yml` to include `paths` filters for source code modifications, configure caching via `actions/cache` or `actions/setup-python` for dependencies, and split independent execution steps into parallel jobs.
result.next_action: Modify `.github/workflows/codeql.yml` to implement path filtering, dependency caching, and parallel execution jobs.
